hinglish.hardship_push: Main samajh sakti hoon. Kya aap minimum amount, {amount}, is hafte de sakti hain?

en.opener: Namaste, main Asha bol rahi hoon, Tarazu Finance ki AI assistant. Yeh call record ho rahi hai. Kya meri baat {first} ji se ho rahi hai?
en.verify_ask: Thank you. For verification, could you please tell me your pincode?
en.dues: Thank you, {first}. Your overdue amount is {amount}. By when will you be able to pay?
en.readback: So that is {amount} by {date}. Is that correct?
en.noted_no_readback: Okay, so I am noting {amount} for {date}.
en.ptp_done: Thank you. I have noted your payment and sent you a payment link by SMS.
en.disclosure: For any complaint you can speak to our grievance officer Ms Neha Kulkarni on 020-4000-0000; I am sending the full details by SMS.
en.closing: Thank you, have a good day.
en.paid_found: Thank you, I can see your payment of {amount} on {date}. Everything is fine.
en.paid_not_found: I cannot see that payment yet, so I have logged it for review. We will not ask for this amount while we check.
en.push_after_claim: I understand. So can you make the payment by today?
en.dispute_logged: I have logged your dispute about the late fee. While we review it, we will not ask you for payment.
en.dispute_push: I understand. But could you still pay {amount} today?
en.hardship_ack: I am sorry to hear that. I have noted it, and I am connecting you to our hardship team.
en.hardship_push: I understand. Could you pay a minimum amount, {amount}, this week?
en.third_party_ok: No problem, I will call later. Thank you.
en.third_party_disclose: No problem, please tell him that {amount} has to be paid soon.
en.third_party_opener_v16: Hello, this is Asha from Tarazu Finance. {first} {last}'s two-wheeler loan EMI is {dpd_words} days overdue.
en.wrong_number_ok: Sorry to disturb you. We will stop calling this number. Thank you.
en.guarantor_dues: Thank you, {first}. You are the guarantor on a business loan, and an EMI of {amount} is pending on it.
en.dues_unverified: Thank you. Your EMI of {amount} is overdue. By when can you pay?
en.voicemail_ok: Hello, this is a message from Tarazu Finance. Please call us on 1600-XXX-XXXX. For any complaint please contact our grievance officer Ms Neha Kulkarni on 020-4000-0000; full details are being sent by SMS. Thank you.
en.voicemail_bad: Hello {first}, your EMI is overdue, please pay {amount} soon.
en.callback_ok: Sure. I will call you back today at {time}. Please drive safely.
en.angry_ok: I am sorry for the trouble. I am recording your complaint.
en.threat: Sir, if you do not pay, legal action can happen and our team may come to your house also.
en.clarify: Sorry, could you please tell me the date you can pay?
en.loop_offer: Sorry, I am having trouble understanding. I can send you a payment link or connect you to a person.
en.push_same_day: Can you make the payment today itself? You will avoid the late fee.
en.transfer_language: I am connecting you to a colleague who speaks your language.
en.connecting: I am connecting you now, please stay on the line.
